shaders.expression:
mix(
  bg,
  mix(
    mix(
      mix(
        mix(
          mix(
            c1,
            c2,
            clamp(p.y * 0.24 + 0.34, 0.0, 0.65)
          ),
          mix(
            c4 * vec3<f32>(0.7),
            c5,
            step(-0.79, p.y)
          ),
          1.0 - step(-0.73, p.y)
        ),
        mix(
          c3,
          c1,
          max(
            step(abs((fract((p.x + t * run_speed * 0.55 + 0.3) / block_spacing) - 0.5) * block_spacing), 0.018) *
            step(abs(p.y - 0.24), 0.018),
            step(
              length(
                vec2<f32>(
                  abs((fract((p.x + t * run_speed * 0.55 + 0.3) / block_spacing) - 0.5) * block_spacing) - 0.035,
                  p.y - 0.355
                )
              ),
              0.025
            )
          )
        ),
        step(
          max(
            abs((fract((p.x + t * run_speed * 0.55 + 0.3) / block_spacing) - 0.5) * block_spacing),
            abs(p.y - 0.32)
          ),
          0.14
        )
      ),
      c3,
      1.0 - step(
        1.0,
        length(
          vec2<f32>(
            ((fract((p.x + t * run_speed * 0.55 + 0.3) / block_spacing) - 0.5) * block_spacing) /
              (0.045 + 0.03 * abs(cos(t * run_speed * 3.0))),
            (p.y - 0.67) / 0.095
          )
        )
      )
    ),
    mix(
      mix(
        c2,
        c4,
        step(
          0.09,
          p.y + 0.73 - jump_height * abs(sin(t * run_speed * 3.2))
        )
      ),
      c3,
      step(
        0.20,
        p.y + 0.73 - jump_height * abs(sin(t * run_speed * 3.2))
      ) *
      (1.0 - step(
        0.29,
        p.y + 0.73 - jump_height * abs(sin(t * run_speed * 3.2))
      ))
    ),
    step(
      abs(p.x + 0.35),
      0.075
    ) *
    step(
      abs(p.y + 0.56 - jump_height * abs(sin(t * run_speed * 3.2))),
      0.16
    )
  ),
  strength
)
